after.text: The six internal/interop environments conformance cases (TestConformanceSnapshotAcquisition, TestConformanceContextVersions, TestConformanceContextResolution, TestConformanceEnvironmentsHeader, TestConformanceEnvironmentsMonolithic, TestConformanceContextDetectors) are declared in .github/ci/platform-cases.tsv with skip_allowed_on=linux,darwin,windows and class root-content. skip-classes.tsv marks root-content policy allow, which applies in every lane including the candidate lane. CI_REQUIRE_FULL_ROOT=1 makes only a suite-plan DEFERRAL fatal, and a deferral only happens for artefacts declared in .github/ci/root-artifacts.tsv. Because internal/interop declares none of the environments vector families there, a candidate root that stopped publishing vectors/environments.json, context-versions.json, context-detectors.json or snapshot-acquisition.json would let the candidate lane pass with all six cases silently skipped. That is the exact failure class stage (a) review finding F9 named: a gate installed but never run.

Either the environments conformance tests move into their own package whose root artefacts are registered in root-artifacts.tsv (so a root that does not serve them defers the package and the candidate lane fails closed), or an equivalent mechanism makes a missing environments family fatal in a lane that requires a fully-serving root. Proven by: gate-selftest.sh green; a run against a curator-spec root with one environments vector removed fails the candidate lane by name.
